dog.description_text: Meet Higgins! If you're looking for a best friend who's always ready for the next adventure, Higgins is your guy! This sweet, wiggly 2-year-old boy is full of life, love, and tail wags. Whether he's greeting you with his signature full-body wiggle or zooming around the yard with pure joy, Higgins knows how to make every day a little brighter. Higgins is an energetic pup who would thrive with an adopter ready to include him in playtime, walks, and plenty of fun. Higgins is more than happy to soak up affection and remind you just how sweet he is. If you’re ready to meet the sweetest boy, click the “Adopt Me” button to learn more about Higgins! *You can meet animals located at the ASPCA Adoption Center during our walk-in hours (daily, noon to 5 p.m.). We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
dog.name: HIGGINS
